name: R09 Labour Cost per FTE by Cost Center

statements:
SELECT
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_REGION,
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_JOURNAL_LINES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5000 AND 5099 THEN GL_JOURNAL_LINES.EXPENSE_AMOUNT END)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS,
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_PERIODS  FISCAL_PERIODS,
  CNR_FIN.GL_JOURNAL_LINES  GL_JOURNAL_LINES
WHERE
  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.COST_CENTER_ID=COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_ID  )
  AND  ( GL_JOURNAL_LINES.PERIOD_ID=FISCAL_PERIODS.PERIOD_ID  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR = 2025 )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_PERIODS.FISCAL_YEAR,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_REGION

SELECT
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_REGION,
  SUM(COST_CENTERS.HEADCOUNT)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.COST_CENTERS  COST_CENTERS
GROUP BY
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_NAME,
  COST_CENTERS.COST_CENTER_REGION
